Best food in Ho Chi Minh hands down
Dec 2023 • Family
Miss Thu in the Fusion Original in Ho Chi Minh is fantastic! The bar has an amazing view especially for sunset, the cocktails are sooooo good (especially the Pretty Savage cocktail), and the staff are lovely. However the restaurant food is just out of this world! This talented chef should have a Michelin star for sure - it's honestly some of the best food we've ever eaten. The Wagyu Pho was divine, the lamb shanks and Loc Luc so tender, and the scallops absolutely delicious. This place is a hidden gem - don't wait, go today.

Fusion Original Saigon
Mar 2023
We stayed at Fusion Original Saigon and had breakfast every morning at Miss Thu. We loved the varieties of choices and also the a la carte choices from the menu. It's not just the food that was amazing but the special Coffee that is made fresh. We ordered this every coffee every morning. It's called Miss Thu Cà Phê Trüng. 
Hanh was our barista and we felt so bad asking for this every morning. It's not easy getting the froth perfect but she did and the taste was catered to our taste buds. It wasn't too sweet or too bitter. She even specified two ways to drink this coffee. Sip on froth first then stir to blend the coffee and remainder froth. Or just stir all together. Warning there is absolute vodka in it😁

The hotel was beautiful and its central in Ho Chi Minh City District 1. It's located inside Saigon Centre which shopping is very convenient for high end shops or if you wanted to it's 5 min walk away from Ben Thanh Market. Also Saigon Market(better prices) is just right across the street from Sedona suites enterance. 

Overall the staff was great and very attentive. We appreciate them and how they made sure our stay very very comfortable.

Impeccable service at this restaurant
Mar 2023 • Solo
Food 5/5, Service 5/5, Ambience 5/5, City view 5/5. What more do I need to say?

I ordered the caviar as a starter and pork as the main both of which were recommended by Thuy ( who is an amazing person )

The chef ( Arnaud - I hope I got that right ) specifically brought the food to my table and furthermore gave me an explanation on the sources of ingredients and what I should pair my meal with

The portions are massive and I didn’t have room for dessert. However, the chef made me a complimentary dessert- the tiramisu which was simply superb. The type I have never had before

A true 5 star experience. Keep it up guys!
